reviews.text: The team was very organized, clean, and super friendly. Gabriella specifically was very helpful, informative, and professional teaching me more about my bearded dragon. If you have an exotic animal that needs a check up, this is the spot you need to go to.
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We’re so glad you had a positive experience with our team.
Very nice staff
Dr C, Mara and Sara are the best.. could not be happier they are here for my parrot babies!!

This is my 3rd visit with this STA&Exotic hospital and not enough words of praise for this place. Staff are very professional and friendly. Upon my 3rd visit, I brought in my leopard gecko to have debris in nostrils removed on both sides. Dr. Natalie and Kim were amazing and finished in no time.  Not to mention prices in general for services are very affordable!  I strongly recommend anyone looking for an exotic reptile hospital, come this place. You won’t regret it.

I had an excellent experience at South Texas Avian Hospital with Dr. Sharman Hoppes and the entire staff. From the very first phone call to arriving at the clinic, everyone was incredibly kind, caring, and professional. The front desk staff, Dr. Hoppes, and her assistant were all so gentle and patient with my Green Cheek Conures, Luna and Timmy, and they truly made them feel comfortable during their visit.

I brought both of my green cheek conures in for wellness checks, and because Luna has been having a foul odor. They discovered she has a yeast infection, and I’m still waiting on additional results from the full panel that was done for her. I really appreciated how thorough they were and how clearly they explained everything to me. They reassured me they would personally follow up with me once the remaining results come in.

What stood out the most to me was that I never once felt rushed. I was able to ask every question I had, and they took the time to explain everything in detail until I fully understood. I left feeling confident, informed, and reassured that my birds were receiving the best care possible. I also truly appreciate how quickly they send a detailed follow-up email after the visit recapping everything discussed and their recommendations for your pet.

They were also very considerate when it came to treatment options and estimates. They explained pricing clearly, gave us time to discuss what we wanted to do, and never made us feel pressured.

Overall, I had a wonderful experience, and even though I drove over four hours to get there, I would absolutely do it again to keep my little green cheek conures healthy. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate and knowledgeable avian care. (It’s expensive but it’s worth it… anything to keep my feathered babies healthy)
Thank you!
The staff made my first experience so good. Very polite & you can see their care for animals. They have no issues with answering any questions or concerns. I would recommend this place for your pet!

I took my ferret Samuel for a foreign body surgery a couple months back…let’s just say it was the most stressful/upsetting experience ever! I was devastated. Everyone at the South Texas Avian was so amazing and made the stressful situation a lot better for me and my ferret. Samuel is thriving months later and i couldn’t be anymore grateful for the team at South Texas Avian!

Our experience here has been wonderful.  We have a guinea pig that became ill with a UTI.  We had previously been seen at an animal hospital closer to us, but we needed an immediate appointment and they were able to see us the same day.  We saw Dr. Natalie Antinoff, and while we have seen many wonderful veterinarian's over the years, Dr. Antinoff engaged one of our children to ask them various questions about what they knew about the guinea's illness or why something may be happening.  I loved that she included our child in the care of our animal and used it as a moment to 'teach' them about animal care.  What a wonderful practitioner and a fantastic way to introduce veterinary medicine to children.  We felt well cared for and included in the treatment plan.  From the front desk to the emails we received on lab results this is a very professional but caring and friendly practice.

Dr. Coke and his staff were extremely kind and took me as a walk-in. In what felt like but wasn’t really an emergency; you know how it is when you love your pets and they seem sick. They explained the process and took me as quickly as possible. They were very thorough and made sure my rabbit got the best care. I would recommend them to anyone looking for an exotic pet vet.
Thank you for your review. If you have any further feedback that can help us improve our level of service, we would love to hear it.

I brought my ferret from out of town to see an exotic specialist and I am more than pleased with my experience at this clinic. All of the staff and technicians were so sweet, and Dr. Antinoff was more than throughout with her examination and care for my baby. It is obvious that everyone that works here loves their job!

My ferret got loved on so much! I am happy to keep coming back

The best place to bring your pets. Hands down. We first brought our two conures here for a routine check up. When we had an emergency with one of them, the empathy and care they held while a bird was being treated.
Thank you!

Dr. Sharman Hoppes is undoubtedly one of the most exceptional avian veterinarians I’ve encountered. Her expertise and passion for bird care truly set her apart in the field. What I find particularly heartwarming is that she shares her life with parrots and other feathered companions, just like mine. This personal connection enriches her understanding of our pets’ needs, making her not only a knowledgeable professional but also a compassionate caregiver.

Having a remarkable veterinarian is essential when it comes to caring for pets that feel like family. It's a crucial aspect of responsible pet ownership that shouldn't be overlooked. The bond we share with our feathered friends deserves the utmost attention and care, and having someone as dedicated as Dr. Hoppes ensures that our beloved birds receive the best possible treatment and support. I feel incredibly grateful to have her as a part of my pet's care team.

This is the best place to take your ferrets! I had two ferrets and unfortunately one didn’t get to meet the amazing staff that this place has. My remaining ferret got to see the excellent Dr. Coke! He really explains everything to you and takes his time. He even played with my ferret for a little while trying to examine said extremely wiggly ferret, haha. He is very patient with my ferret as well which I’d never seen before at other veterinary places. I will forever recommend this doctor to anyone who owns exotics! Their prices are also very very reasonable, especially for exotics! They’re so understanding and helpful! I trust them with my ferret needs!
A wonderful vet for your feathered friend! Not only did they take wonderful care of my African Grey, but it was a true pleasure working with them and getting to know them. I will be back!
Took my hedgehog and they were so kind and patient with her , she’s all healed now and doing great as ever 😊
Thank you for your review!
Thanks for your review Emily!
Thanks for your review Kristin!

Had a scare with my leopard gecko and before coming here I had taken him to other clinics but always left with doubt. After making an appointment with Dr. Coke not only is my boy doing wonderfully but I am more confident in his health overall. I was met with excellent service, a welcoming environment, and knowledgeable staff. My leopard gecko is doing wonderfully now and if anything should arise in the future, I will be bringing him back here!!

From the moment I talked to Mara and got a next day appointment for my sick Koi, I was already impressed.  Then I met Dr. Coke and Gabriella and they were incredible!  Dr. Coke is extremely knowledgeable, down to earth and compassionate and Gabriella was a perfect assistant! I actually thought to myself, how could I have been so lucky to find them.  After thinking I might lose my 20yr old Koi he is now making steady progress and seems to be improving a little more each day with Dr. Coke's treatment plan.  I feel very fortunate to have found them and I have hope now that my beautiful Koi fish will live to swim for many more years to come!  Also, very affordable for the level of expertise I received, worth every penny and more.

The doctor was so incredibly knowledgeable, loving, attentive, and took a lot of time with us.  Even though it wasn’t an emergency, he knew that mom and dad thought it was and treated it as such.  I would recommend him to anyone all day long!!!

This place is absolutely amazing!! I went in today with my bearded dragon to get a second opinion and I'm so happy I did. The whole staff was incredibly nice and welcoming as soon as I walked in the door. I had taken my beardie to a vet who said treated reptiles/exotic animals but very quickly into the evaluation, I realized that Dr. Coke's knowledge and expertise were on another level. Both Dr. Coke and Sara truly are reptile experts. The examination was extremely thorough and I even got to listen to my beardie's heartbeat for the first time! They were gentle with him throughout the exam and Dr. Coke and Sara were very warm and friendly. I immediately felt comfortable and at ease with them handling him. I left the appointment feeling extremely happy and satisfied with the diagnosis since Dr. Coke truly evaluated EVERYTHING! Even my beardie didn't get black beard and seemed as comfortable as one could be during a physical examination. I will definitely come back here for all of my beardie's future wellness checks. Thank you Dr. Coke and Sara for being so wonderful today!!

This place is totally amazing ! They were so kind and helpful as well as very informative! They also got me seen very fast due to it being a emergency, I was also really impressed with Gabriella she was very personable and patient with me I had my kids with me so I was already overwhelmed she made me feel very welcome. 10/10 customer service from everyone here I would recommend this place!

Absolutely-Outstanding Clinic, Dr Coke and all his staff are amazing. Speaking from a General Practice Vet Tech point of view, this place is great for your exotics. Wonderful staff and Dr- facility is great and very clean and full of decorations. I was seated very quickly into a room- the wait normally isn't long as I've been here a few times before with my Hedgehogs.
The prices are also fair for a Bord Certified Specialist; but with a very experienced vet like Dr. Coke, Every Penny is worth it!!!
They were able to get my Cockatiel Sora, in for an exam with short notice due to some changes with his calls. Dr. Coke was very patient with my ornery Sora and he was also patient with me and my 20 questions. I will always come here with my exotics!

I recently brought my bearded dragon to this clinic due to lethargy and a noticeable decrease in appetite. While the front desk staff was friendly and knowledgeable, I was disappointed with how my pet was handled during the visit. The handling felt rough and made me uncomfortable, especially considering the stress my little girl was already under.

During the initial exam, Dr. Coke ran a fecal test and bloodwork. Although I tried to trust his expertise, I felt the examination lacked gentleness and clear communication. When I explained my concerns, I was simply told she was going into brumation due to a change in her nighttime heating routine. I was assured I would receive bloodwork results the following day.

However, when I called the next afternoon, I learned that only one of the tests had been completed, and I was told everything appeared normal. I did not receive the remaining results until Monday, leaving me feeling uninformed despite being promised next-day updates.

When I called on Monday for clarification, I was finally able to speak directly with Dr. Coke. He seemed short with me and stated that he had already emailed the results. I asked to go over them since I had him on the phone, and he explained that my bearded dragon was likely entering brumation and that her elevated toxic cells were “normal.” Also my beardie was sexed during the examination as female and the bloodwork I was emailed said male. After researching the significance of toxic cells, I became concerned and sought a second opinion with a different veterinarian, who immediately prescribed antibiotics and vitamins.

Considering I paid over $500 for this visit, I expected better communication, more compassionate handling, and clearer explanations. Unfortunately, my experience felt unprofessional and dismissive, and I did not feel that my pet’s well-being—or my concerns as her owner—were treated with the care they deserved. I will not be returning to this clinic.
Thank you for your review!
Thank you so much for taking great care of my frog, Linus! Definitely a great experience!

Never owned a bird, but the recently got one and thought it was acting strangely so took it in. Turns out it's appointment only, but they were able to squeeze me in after about an hour.

Everyone was very nice.

Dr Coke saved “Ronaldo” our bearded dragon’s life with a cutting edge blood aneurysm surgery, and also spotted a 2nd aneurysm inside his mouth and repaired that too! Dr Coke laid out every risk, as this is a brand new surgery, honestly a 50/50 shot- we trusted Dr Coke completely. Ronaldo is thriving!!! Their honesty and expertise mean everything. The staff couldn’t have been any sweeter: they treated us like family and made sure Ronaldo was comfy during his stay. We highly recommend South Texas Avian & Exotic Hospital !
I bring all my chickens here. The staff is wonderful and they've taken care of all of the wild issues that have come up with my flock.

Wonderful caring staff. Dr. Coke was fantastic, so so knowledgeable about my Sun Conures. When searching for an Avian Vet I found South Texas and I am so glad I did. Thank you from a very happy bird Momma 🥰 …
I can only recommend this place.  The staff is super nice and I feel very comfortable taking my rabbit over there.  Thank you very much
A baby boy Eclectus getting his checkup.

My goodness Dr.Coke & his wonderful team saved my fancy Leopard Geckos life 🥹 I am so grateful🙏🏻 they did an amazing job and the staff was so kind. 10 out of 10 experience. Rex is expected to fully recover from his eye situation 🙏🏻Thank you …
Great hospital! Gabriella was great!
From the front desk to Dr. Coke, the staff was extremely professional and caring. They worked quickly and calmly to assure our BeetleGoose got the best care! Thank yall so much for what you do!
Professional and courteous. Knowledge, kind, and empathetic. They took care of my little sugar gliders!

Great vet to go to, I’ve been to others around San Antonio and south Texas avian& exotic is definitely now my preferred vet. Dr.Coke was extremely helpful and communicative in the process of treating my Tegu lizard for a prolapse.

Fantastic doctor who shows his expertise the moment he is examining your pet. The price was half the amount as other vets we looked at and took care of our lizard wonderfully. We will always be going here from now on.
We took our baby Uromastyx Slith to STAEH and they were so great! They answered all of our questions and gave us nutritional supplements to help boost his appetite. He is already getting better!

Dr Coke and his staff there are absolutely amazing. They took excellent care of our fur babies and very informative of the procedures and everything that will have to take place. Thank y'all so much y'all have become our new primary vet for our ferrets.

Everything was excellent, the service was super friendly and fast. The doctor was super kind and explained everything in detail. A good price. I'm so happy with my baby Nico's doctor. Thank you so much.

Bright & welcoming setting. Team members made the appointment convenient, helped with initial paperwork & were enthusiastic. Dr. Coke made a thorough exam and recommended a course of action.  Since I was from San Angelo, he offered to coordinate care with my local veterinarian. This exotic animal hospital is s great resource and a San Antonio gem!

I could not have been happier with the care and attention that was given to my feathered baby by both the Vet and the staff. The level of knowledge and compassion is exceptional. Any beloved creature brought in will be in the best of hands here.
Got my lizard taken care of under 2 hours and was a very nice staff and very helpful

My Husband and I took our Green Cheek Conure in today for a check up and I was behind satisfied. The entire staff is all so friendly and professional. Sara who i had been conversing with for a couple of days was an Angel and made sure I was aware of prices, procedures and even gave me references to other helpful information about GCC's. Dr. Coke was so amazing as well. He was knowledgeable and was able to address my concerns for my GCC who has been having seizures. I left the appointment in relief knowing I have a great place I can take my GCC for check ups in the future. Would give a million stars if I could! Thanks to all that assisted me and Zellie today!
Outstanding service. Knowledgeable. Professional & Sympathetic

I am so thankful I found this place. Dr. Coke and his staff are all so amazing and wonderful. I thought we were going to lose our little Cookie girl for sure, but she is making great strides towards recovery now. I can not give this place enough praise to express my gratitude for everyone here and all you guys have done to help our little rattie. From the moment you walk into the door, you're treated like family. Dr. Coke was so caring, easy to talk to, and he really knows  what he's doing . He explained everything cookie would need to have done and how to take care of her at home. Just in case she managed to slip her bandage, he sent home supplies to patch her back up. I LOVE it when you find a doctor who  absolutely loves what they do because it just shows in the way they care for their patients and in their beside manner. My only regret is that I took cookie somewhere else before South Texas Avian and Exotics Clinic. For anyone who is having doubts for any reason or looking for something  a bit less expensive, I urge you to remember that you get what you pay for. ( I say this because i made the mistake of calling around to find the best price, instead of the best doctor for the job) But, If you want the very best for your little one, who offers treatments no one else does, this is absolutely the place to go. You won't be disappointed. You won't feel rushed to get in and out and you won't be left with unanswered questions or concerns...most importantly you can relax and  take comfort in knowing that your little one is in very capable hands and recieving the very best care and attention and is definitely getting head rubs and loved on by the staff throughout their stay. I would never recommend anywhere but South Texas Avian & Exotics. (Sorry for the super long review it was very hard to fit all the things I loved into just a few lines)

This clinic was recommended to us by our exotic vet in LA. Our bearded dragon, Joey, needed to get spayed. The staff here is absolutely amazing! Dr. Coke & the front desk personnel are very knowledgeable, accommodating, caring, and patient. They answered all our questions and made us feel like Joey was in great hands! Thank you for being here for us & our beloved beardie!!!

We took in our cockatiel Lola in for egg binding after a long night in the emergency vet in austin. Dr. Coke was able to remove her egg and all of the staff was so amazing. They got us in super quick and made such a scary situation so much better! Lola is doing great and they even checked in on her a few days after.

I was referred to this clinic by my existing vet for my ball python, Bean. An anomaly was spotted near his heart in x-rays done related to his pneumonia and the vet suggested that I see a specialist and referred me to Dr. Coke. I was able to get in immediately and have never experienced a more professional and knowledgeable vet, especially when it comes to snakes. His handling of Bean was amazing because it would've made Bean nervous if I tried to do some of the things he did. It shows just how much he knows about snakes. We got the best news that Bean seems fine for now and no expensive measures were necessary at this time. I love my snakes and will bring them back here even though it's a drive since I live out of town. The staff was amazing!
Great place, great people

They were absolutely wonderful.  They cared for my sugar glider quickly and were so sweet with her. Checked on her once we were home and made sure to notify me when the test results came in. I would wholeheartedly recommend them to any one.

I don't usually review places, but the clinic has my respect! My cockatiel was seen as soon as possible and the staff were very professional. They answered all my questions and made sure I left with everything needed. Dr. Coke and his staff are very nice and you won't regret coming in to this location.

Thank you so much to Dr. Coke, Gabby and Sara -- I bought Tater Tot in for a routine health check since he'd been eating less since I went away for a trip -- sure enough there was a seminal plug that must have been so uncomfortable.

Post visit I'm changing out my lighting and thermostat and replacing his multivitamin. He's eating and back to his snarky self.

Could not be more grateful for their expertise.
Thank you, Cristal!

My nerves are finally calmed knowing these folks are in town now. Had a scare with my green cheek and they were able to immediately get me in for an exam. Dr. Coke was incredibly friendly and informative. The appointment didn't feel rushed at all and Dr. Coke seemed to know exactly what he was doing. The city seems to be severely lacking in good exotic vets (particularly avian vets), so Ive been worried about my boys not getting the medical care they need. Not worried anymore with Dr. Coke here! Will be taking my entire flock for their checkups here from now on. Oh and Sara at the front desk was incredibly kind, patient, and checked in on us while waiting for Dr. Coke multiple times. She also called the following week to check in and make sure my little Comet was doing well.
Every one was so lovely! <3  Squirtle came off as a menace hopefully next time he’s nicer to everyone :,) Thank you guys ^v^

Went to Dr. Coke to have a checkup for my hedgehog Gretal; because I noticed cataract issues. Appointment went smoothly. Clinic was very nice and clean, staff seemed well organized. Dr Coke was very informative and confirmed my suspicion of blindness with Gretal. Will be back with my Avians next visit.
Thank you!
Thank goodness this clinic finally is here. Now there is an actual specialist for all of us who like pets that are a little "different".
Wonderful clinic! The Dr is very knowledgeable, his wife is wonderful unfortunately couldn't find the front door. Photo is misleading.
Pleasant doctor and his wife was great!
Thank you!
Thank you!
Thank you!

Took my elderly Chihuahua who had an existing heart conditionto to Dr. Coke. It was unfortunate that there was nothing we could do but Dr.Coke did an amazing job making sure she had a good couple of last days. He was very informative and thorough.
Dr. Coke saw our silkie who was being bullied by our bigger roosters. We weren't sure if he was going to make it. With Dr cokes expertise our boy is doing amazing!

I was referred to this new clinic by my existing vet who could not take an emergency appointment for my rabbit. I was really impressed by this facility and the staff. Emergency rabbit care pretty much everywhere is somewhat expensive. I'd say the same applied to this visit, but the way the staff was so patient, caring, and Dr. Rob Coke was extremely knowledgable on rabbits and what is needed for them emergency wise-- it was well worth it and I never felt "ripped off" but rather that everything STA&EH did was for the benefit of my rabbit. They are very honest and completely up front with pet owners, something that is becoming very elusive as private equity continues to oversee vet offices. Visiting South Texas Avian and Exotic is very worth it. I'd recommend that rabbit owners always have two vets available, especially one that can take emergencies, schedule an appointment and make your rabbit an existing patient here. Thank you South Texas Avian and Exotic Hospital
This clinic takes incredible care of both patients and clients! Very thorough and informative, taking their time to explain and happy to field questions.

I very much appreciate all of the work that goes on here. I had the unfortunate timing of having to visit 3 times in about a week but was met with a friendly atmosphere each time. I also very much appreciate the check up actually happening in the room as opposed to my rats being taken back to where I can't see and then brought back. It's a nice, reassuring touch.
Dr. Coke and staff are fantastic and very thorough and careful with our avians. Highly recommended!
